programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When popular GP, Doctor Alan Delaney borrows fellow Dr. James Kirkwood's new car to do an evening call-out. He is mysteriously killed in a hit and run during a drive through woods in a thunderstorm. Barnaby and Jones start investigating in Midsomer Market and discover that James may have been the intended victim. The case leads them to North Walesformer home of Delyth Mostyn, James's fiance to delve further.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the pretty village of Luxton Deeping, there's fierce conflict between the traditional film and modern digital photographers. When their societies committee decide not to accept digital images at the annual photographic exhibition, it appears to make things worse. It leads to a confrontation at the private view. The following day Lionel Bell is found murdered in woodland, strangled with the cord of his light meter.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The inhabitants of Midsomer Magna are in the spotlight, quite literally when a production crew descend on the village and imposing Manor House. To film a version of The Scarlet Pimpernel. Not only the film crew arrive, but a notorious criminal as well, George Ince, lurking around the Manor. When Nick Cheney, the film's director is found dead, by the use of the prop guillotine. The detectives need to sift through many motives which lead to the complexity.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Midsomer Holm, a rehabilitation scheme for reformed criminals continues. When Ronnie Tyler departs, he gets a good send off from everyone, including DCI Barnaby. Another attendee is Jack Colby, a disgraced ex-policeman and former colleague of Barnaby. Jack is decidedly frosty towards his once-former friend and refuses to chat. When Jack is later murdered, Barnaby must search for answers in Jack's past for motives.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Down at the prestigious Whiteoaks Golf Club, there is much rivalry and snobbery amongst its members. When Alistair Kingslake is coerced into the thicket to look for his ball on the notorious 13th hole, known as Crisp's Folly, he soon gets bludgeoned to death. There's many suspects, from fellow members, several villagers who only have limited time on the course and the club's staff. It is not long before another member is found stabbed in woodland close to the course.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a newly discovered treasure by the 19th-century landscape artist Henry Hogson, makes an impression, it is later sold at auction for 400,000. Shortly after the previous owner of the artwork is tortured and killed. The following day another Hogson is stolen in a burglary and Barnaby finds himself having to investigate both. In order to get success, he needs to become an expert on Hogson with the help of art teacher Matilda Simms, they uncover many hidden secrets, deception and more.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Former secret agent Geoffrey Larkin arrives in the village of Midsomer Parva and heads for a visit to Allenby House, a country manor run by former spies, the Frazer family as a safe house. With an air of hostility towards Geoffrey, it is not long before he is murdered, by some who blame the 'beast of Midsomer', who believe the creature exists. Barnaby, a former spy himself, gets involved in the case.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: George Jeffers, a professor of Midsomer University and cycling enthusiast, threatens to go public, he is found with his state-of-the-art invention Kernel Logic. This angers American software boss Clinton Finn and fears he will lose millions if the truth is exposed. When schoolteacher Emily Harte is killed in a hit and run, things become more complicated. With someone known as 'the Bucketman' throwing red paint over cars belonging to employees of a local computer firm, among others.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In Little Worthy, model maker Bob Moss was just going to open his beloved model village, when he stumbled across the body of young Richard Tanner. He had been stabbed and his corpse tied down like Gulliver in the stories of Lilliput. Barnaby and Jones start questioning all the villagers and discover many quirky characters in the process. When the girl Richard was secretly meeting in the grounds of the model village, is murdered during the Crazy Craft Race.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A cat burglar known as 'the Creeper' could be responsible for murder, not just burglaries. When a writer friend David Roper is found smothered in bed on the Chettham family estate, a few days after arriving. The police soon learn that Mr Roper had been planning to write a book that could have exposed many Chettham family secrets of years past. That would make someone quiet uneasy and edgy. The mystery deepens when a second victim who knew the family is shot in woodland.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A school teacher Connie Bishop, Nancy Carroll, who is known to sleepwalk, begins to believe that she has slit the throats of her mentor and a local handyman. Her friends are not convinced that she is to blame; neither does Barnaby. A local philanthropist and his social climbing wife are planning the annual Frobisher night -- will it go ahead without a hitch? The detectives begin to piece the puzzle together and catch the killer.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A woman's life changes dramatically when she accidentally shoots herself in the head which causes her to not only grow more intelligent, but also to realize how dull her life was before the photo in a picture frame started talking to her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When an incident at a space station leaves three people dead, the captain of the ship returns to Earth to face murder charges. Is the captain a murderous madman? Or has he actually seen the face of evil floating in the zero-gravity of deep space?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The residents of a suburban neighborhood have their lives turned upside down when a four block section of their subdivision is ripped from the earth by a mysterious force and transported to a distant planet. David McCallum and Laura Harris star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Muckraking TV journalist Donald Rivers (Alan Thicke), host of "The Whole Truth," has the show of a lifetime: rock solid-proof that the government and private defense contractors have been engaging in secret genetic cloning.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Using an experimental treatment, a scientist (Pat Morita) helps an aging athlete (Adrian Pasdar) end his career on a high note by accelerating his reflexes for one last match. But with victory comes side-effects...courtesy of The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a society controlled by aliens, a mother rebels when she is forced to give up her child to Mother, a wise alien who acts as a parent to all infants. Determined to get the child back, she embarks upon a dangerous quest that will change her world.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Genetic Engineering creates super-babies, some suffer from Genetic Rejection Syndrome (GRS), making them stronger and more deadly. A detective (Gary Cole) must stop his GRS son, a suspected killer, but must take a serum to become more like him.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Hunters pay to hunt androids that have a chip that keeps them from harming humans. However, secretly planted data allows the androids to disable the chip, and the balance of power shifts between men and machines! Starring Ron White and Doug Savant.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Xenobiologist Teresa Janovitch (Melissa Gilbert) is on a military team searching an uninhabited planet for minerals. When the team is attacked by aliens and a retaliation is successful, Janovitch makes a shocking discovery about the victims.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Reporter Judy Warren (Kate Vernon) tracks down Josh (Alex McArthur), a recluse who performs miracles. Alien or angel? All that Judy knows is that now the military is involved and she doesn’t trust them. If she can help Josh, will she find the truth?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A medical specialist (Peter Flemming) examines a case involving an epidemic that killed a number of children in a small town. Through hypnosis, he probes the mind of a surviving child (Rachel Leigh Cook) and unravels a memory of "alien" proportions.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: As part of a top-secret program, the brain content of a military Captain (Lou Diamond Phillips) is temporarily transferred to an android to create a superior soldier. But, when things go wrong, can the transfer be reversed? Also starring Robert Joy.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A group of hospital patients and their nurse, Marie Alexander (Maria Conchita Alonso), survive a global, terrorist bio-attack. A vaccine arrives, but there are only three doses. Who will be chosen? Will it be survival of the fittest?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Bernard (Ayre Gross) is haunted by images from his past and the tragic death of his sister...a death he caused. An experimental treatment brings positive results, but also a dangerous side effect: Bernard can now transfer his fear to others!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a transport ship Captain (C. Thomas Howell) is rescued after surviving a devastating crash on Venus, strange things begin to happen when he returns to Earth. He did what it took to survive on Venus, but could the price of survival be too high?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A scientist (Gregory Harrison) in a colony on another planet urges evacuation when he discovers that a radioactive star will soon pass over. He has been wrong before, though, and at great cost. Will the truth be accepted in time to save the colony?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Charlie Bouton (Tom Butler) and Melburn Ross (Michael Shanks) create Mary 25, a nanny robot. When Bouton falls in love with Mary and mistreats his wife, a woman whom Ross once loved, the lines between human and machine become dangerously blurred.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A negotiator (Brett Cullen) tries to find out why a grad student (Peter Stebbings) is threatening to detonate a deadly, self-made bomb, unless the government kills five people for him. Why those five people? Is it revenge? And can he be stopped?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Four telekinetic people are recruited by the CIA, who hopes to use their talents to assassinate a war criminal. Their powers produce unexpected side-effects; however, and the killers may soon find that they are the prey. Robert Guillaume stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Dr. Nodel (Ron Rifkin) is joined on an alien ship by a small group of students to communicate with aliens, it appears that they’ve all been led into a trap. Have the aliens led them astray? Ryan Reynolds also stars. Sequel to “Double Helix”

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A battle cruiser is captured by the enemy Ebonites on planet N-1-8-4. Imprisoned, the crew is interrogated by The Voice, an unseen Ebonite. Who will be the first to snap? And what will happen then? Starring Maurice Dean Wint and Steven Bauer.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In the world of 2055, men are extinct. Preserved by cryonics, a man (David Keith) awakens in Lithia, a poor matriarchy. He’s welcomed, but when he upsets the natural order of things, the question arises: Can the world men be revived? And should it?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When two archeologists (Lisa Zane, David Cubitt) discover a cocooned alien that suddenly begins to reanimate, the rest of the research team turns greedy, wanting to cash in on it. When the couple refuses, they find themselves numbered...or are they?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An alien (Rene Auberjonois) and his family live on a secure farm on Earth, where they grow their own food. Most of the aliens believe that the human race was wiped out in the war, but there is a group of humans in the woods...and they are starving!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A doctor (Maurice Godin) creates a controversial process to reverse aging and disease. So, when an older woman (Barbara Rush) he loves is close to death, he knows he can save her. But there is always a price to be paid...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: On Mars, the Free Alliance and the Coalition of Middle-Eastern and Pacific States mine minerals under a truce until an apparent attack on Earth. Without clear evidence of war, is retaliation wise, or hasty? Barbara Eve Harris and Adam Baldwin star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A former soldier (Ron Perlman) has horrifying flashbacks from his days as a member of a covert branch of the military. But when flashback star to become reality, he wonders whether he is insane...or if there a new covert mission afoot.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Mac 27 (Nicolas Lea) is Innobotics' newest android. He’s emotionless, but he escapes after a glitch and takes a hostage, Celia (Nana Visitor). She sees human qualities in Mac and tries to convince him that he has feelings. But why help her captor?

programme.title: Infinity
programme.desc: Physicist Richard Feynman (Matthew Broderick) works on nuclear project.

programme.title: Love, Game, Match
programme.desc: When Liz's students create a matchmaking service, they ask her to create a dating profile.

programme.title: A Friend's Betrayal

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Out Of The Cult Follow Up
programme.desc: Dr. Phil follows up with a family whose story captivated viewers. Fourteen siblings say they suffered horrific beatings and molestation at the hands of their own father, who claimed to be the Messiah. The oldest daughter, Jeanne, says she was not only abused by her dad, but was forced to brutally beat her younger brothers and sisters to please their controlling patriarch. After the show, the relatives say they made great strides toward reconciliation, but tension and resentment still exist. Miriam and Sarah say Jeanne doesn’t physically abuse them anymore, but they still feel hurt by her constant judgments. They say she always preaches to them and criticizes them for drinking alcohol and for taking jobs as exotic dancers. Another sibling, Jewel, who recently reconnected with the family after 13 years, says Jeanne is jealous of her new bond with the family. Can the women heal the wounds of the past and move on with their lives?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Deb says a year ago, she discovered her husband, David’s, tangled web of lies and sexual affairs that spanned more than a decade -- and she believes he’s cheated on her at least 1,000 times. David admits he had several inappropriate relationships with other women, but claims he only had two physical affairs, and he’s ended it all. He says Deb’s obsession with proving he’s still unfaithful is destroying their marriage. Can this relationship be saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Can May-December romances really last? Christopher Knight, famous for his role as Peter on The Brady Bunch, and Adrianne Curry, winner on America's Next Top Model, began their relationship when they starred together on the reality show The Surreal Life 4, and the public watched as they planned their wedding on their own show, My Fair Brady. Now they both say their 24-year age difference is a huge problem in their chaotic marriage. Adrianne says Christopher treats her like an employee, and Christopher says if she worked for him, she would’ve been fired a long time ago. Can these two work out their generational differences? Then, 38-year-old Shelly wants to know if it’s wrong to be in a relationship with an 18-year-old friend of her son. She says he makes her feel beautiful, but wonders if she’s causing him or her children harm. Dr. Phil doesn’t mince words when he tells her his opinion.

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: No matter how hard we try to protect ourselves, all of us will experience an unexpected trauma in our lives. Whether it's divorce, an illness or a violent attack, each one of us is a potential victim. When misfortune befalls you, how should you react? Will this be something that poisons you for the rest of your life, or will it be something that you adapt to in a way that you can move on? If you're struggling to overcome a trauma, learn to take back control, stop fueling irrational fears and move forward with your life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The contentious 2020 presidential election has shown that there’s a clear divide in America – half the country is celebrating, and the other half is angry – making the upcoming holiday season especially tricky to navigate. Instead of being a time of joy, celebration and giving thanks, many families are faced with the dilemma of how not to argue with their own spouses, children and parents about politics. Dr. Phil meets a Republican father, who is barely speaking to his Democrat daughter after an argument they had over Donald Trump. Then, Dr. Phil meets another father, a lifelong Democrat, who says he raised his son to be a free thinker ... but never imagined that he’d support Trump! The election is officially over, but the drama remains. What’s Dr. Phil’s advice on how to move forward post- election without turning holiday dinners with family into a war zone over politics? Tune in!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil takes goes inside the unthinkable: making your own child sick to fulfill a disturbing need for attention. The idea might sound unimaginable, but for people with a psychological disorder called Munchausen by Proxy, it's irresistible. Note: Viewer discretion is advised.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Planning the wedding of your dreams can quickly turn into a nightmare. What is supposed to be a bonding experience between moms and daughters often turns into a battleground over everything from money to cake! Kristina and her mom, Cheri, know this all too well. Kristina says her mom’s lies are tearing their relationship apart, and if things don't change, she's uninviting her to the wedding! Will Cheri learn honesty is the best policy, and walk beside her daughter down the aisle? Then, get a front-row seat and behind-the-scenes look at the most special day in Dr. Phil and Robin's life: Jay's wedding. See the preparation, the ceremony and the huge celebration. Plus, the surprise gift of a lifetime from Jay's younger brother, Jordan, and the unique ideas that made this day one the McGraw's will treasure forever. A not-to-miss exclusive!

Since the last show, Kerry says her relationship with her mother-in-law has never been better! Unfortunately, her relationship with her mother has never been worse. Then, Alaina and Ray are married with two children, and they all live with Ray’s mother, Eda. The two women are constantly at each other’s throats and it's threatening the entire family. Is this household too close for comfort, and will they be able to find a solution?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Many little girls dream of the perfect wedding day with a fairytale gown, beautiful flowers and their handsome groom, but Dr. Phil's guests say their wedding bells hit a sour note. Amy says the day she and Steve tied the knot turned into a disaster. The sun scorched the guests, then there was a downpour, the wedding arch fell and hit the pastor, and the cake crumbled as they were cutting it. She says it was a huge dream shattered, and she can't move past it. Steve says he had a blast, and Amy needs to lighten up. What does Dr. Phil think? Then, shortly after Mandy and her husband, Kris, said "I do," a three-story deck collapsed and they and 30 of their family and friends were seriously injured. Mandy says she left her wedding strapped to a stretcher, and she and Kris spent their wedding night in the emergency room. Although this took place over two years ago, the couple thinks about it every day. How can they overcome their guilt? And, Kurt and Brandi recently renewed their vows because they say they wanted a fresh start to their seven-year marriage. Just months after their ceremony, Kurt filed for divorce when he found out a secret Brandi had been keeping. Will the results of polygraph tests inspire this couple to make their marriage work or end it for good?

programme.title: Is It Haunted?
programme.desc: After 1066, William the Conqueror established the mark of his authority in every important place, and the town of Wisbech, at that time on the sea, was deemed worthy of a stone fortress. In 1236, both Town and Castle were swept away in a terrible inundation. The castle remained in ruins for the better half of a century, and then was rebuilt and became one of ten castles, palaces and manor houses attached to the See of Ely. In the times of persecution, Wisbech Castle became a state ecclesiastical prison, incarcerating Catholics in the reigns of Elizabeth, James I and Charles I and Protestants in that of Queen Mary. Many were executed. It is possible even that the Gunpowder Plot was hatched at the Castle. Since Wisbech was a Cromwellian area, the Castle, by now in a state of terminal dilapidation, was sold in 1658 to the Right Honourable John Thurloe, Cromwell’s Secretary of State. He had the ruined castle demolished and replaced it by a most elegant house designed by Peter Mills, a pupil of Inigo Jones. At the Restoration, Thurloe’s Mansion reverted to the See of Ely and was occupied by members of the Southwell family over a period of a hundred and five years. Then in 1792 it was put up for sale, and purchased by Joseph Medworth, a former Wisbech Charity boy who had succeeded in business. He offered it for sale to the Corporation for the use of the Grammar School, but they declined. Medworth had the Mansion demolished. Using much of the same materials, he managed to replace it with the regency villa, which stands today.

On the one hand, it presents real socialist stereotypes like cryptic messages from a frozen time loop, combined with shocking reports on shortages. On the other hand, polished Pyongyang lures with a futuristic skyline, flashy amusement parks and department stores with a range of goods equal to those in western consumer meccas.

programme.title: Mata Hari - The Beautiful Spy
programme.desc: In February 1917 World War I is raging when Mata Hari is arrested in Paris and taken to the examining magistrate. Her very life is at stake: she is accused of high treason. The famous exotic dancer has come to represent beauty and the power of feminine seduction. The documentary Mata Hari - the Beautiful Spy tracks down the true story of this fascinating woman.

programme.title: Osama Bin Laden - Up Close and Personal
programme.desc: Just after midnight on May 2, 2011, United States Special Forces raided the compound in Abbottabad, Pakistan, where Osama Bin laden had been hiding for years. “America’s public enemy number one” was killed during the operation. The Navy SEALs thoroughly searched his house, recovering everything that could provide information about Bin Laden and his terrorist network Al-Qaeda: His documents and private correspondence, as well as every electronic data carrier.

programme.title: The Child Crusades - Barefoot to the Promised Land
programme.desc: In Cologne in 1212 a boy named Nicholas captivated thousands of children between the ages of eight and fifteen with his fanatical speeches. They had been chosen, he said, to liberate Jerusalem. Likewise, in the French town of Cloyes a young shepherd gathered numerous children around him with the same proclamation.

programme.title: Forest of Heroes
programme.desc: From Lower Saxony and North Rhine Westphalia, from Osnabrück to Paderborn, one of Germany’s most beautiful forests extends for some 150 kilometers - the Teutoburg Forest. The low mountain range became famous due to the Varus Battle that took place in 9 AD. It was here that Hermann, or Arminius, the Cherusci Prince vanquished the Roman occupation army.

programme.title: The Battle for the Baltic Sea
programme.desc: It’s in spring 2008, when the telephone of the Archaeological State Office Schleswig-Holstein suddenly rings. The message archeologist Martin Segschneider receives makes him curious.

programme.title: Operation Peter Pan - The Secret War against Cuba
programme.desc: In 2016, a historic moment arrived when Barack Obama spoke in Cuba to the inhabitants of the island nation and promised a future together. For the first time in more than 50 years, an American president had entered the communist country and turned towards an erstwhile enemy. However, the US economic embargo against Cuba continues. It sanctions the socialist state – although the UN General Assembly recently again called it a violation of international law. Many Cubans are therefore sceptical about a new political future, despite the friendly words of the American President. Their distrust is deep. It is based on over fifty years of history and the policies of the United States towards their country. For years, the Cuban government has raised serious allegations against their big neighbour. The film "Operation Peter Pan" tracks these allegations.

programme.title: Monsters and Myths
programme.desc: Monsters have always been part of our nightmares and fairy tales. But where do they actually come from? How much of them is truth, how much is myth? Going to great lengths in this documentary, the filmmakers join scientists to explore a number of the best known sagas and legends in the world.

programme.title: World War A - When Aliens Attack
programme.desc: Scientists are already looking feverishly for evidence of extraterrestrial life. With the ExoMars mission, ESA will soon find life on Mars. If there are only tiny microbes, there could also be life in other places in the universe. But can life in space exist at all? The exobiologist Jean-Pierre de Vera collects microorganisms around the world and tests them in his Mars simulation laboratory. Can they survive under the deadly conditions of Mars? Researchers believe there are planets on which alien life can exist. In 1991 the Swiss astrophysicist Michel Mayor discovered the world's first exoplanet. Since then, about 3,000 planets have been detected outside our solar system. Heike Rauer from the German Aerospace Center is looking for habitable planets. Will she find a second earth? The European Southern Observatory is also searching for life in space, building the largest telescope in the world. In the next 20 years the E-ELT should be able to prove the existence of life on distant planets. How would extraterrestrials look? Some scientists suspect that they may well resemble us humans. Under other environmental conditions, alien life could also arise completely differently. It could be formed from methane and silicon. Different gravity would form alien bodies completely differently. Could extraterrestrials send us messages? At the SETI Institute in California, alien hunters like Seth Shostak are listening to signals from alien civilizations. But mere listening is no longer enough. Some SETI researchers now want to send messages to the aliens themselves. They hope to finally get an answer. But would that be a bad idea? Many scientists warn of the dangers of establishing contact. The former SETI researcher and science fiction author David Brin also fears that it could be a devastating mistake. With well-meant news we could end up attracting attention from hostile civilizations. Should we really tell them that we exist and where they can find us?

programme.title: Crime Scene Eulau - The Mystery of the 13 Skeletons
programme.desc: This documentary focuses on a spectacular discovery made in a quarry near the village of Eulau, not far from the central German town of Naumburg. Neolithic graves contained the skeletons of three women, two men and eight children, buried tenderly 4500 years ago, some affectionately entwined. In 2008, for the first time anywhere in the world, it was possible to perform a DNA analysis on the earliest evidence of the existence of a nuclear family. This was a sensation - but why did these people all die at the same time? Were they the victims of a violent crime? Who were they, and how did this terrible drama unfold? Archaeologists insist that these victims will not be forgotten, since these days it is possible to do far more than simply date and record such finds. Modern scientific methods have revolutionised archaeology, enabling us to discover how and why the family from Eulau in the German state of Sachsen-Anhalt died 4500 years ago. By enlisting the help of a CID profiler, archaeologists and anthropologists employ state-of-the-art analytical methods to investigate this Stone Age crime. In the process we discover key information about an era before recorded history which has previously been shrouded in mystery - and astonishing information about the composition of the population here also comes to light. It seems that the third millennium before Christ saw two major waves of migration, from Eastern and Western Europe, which determine the composition of the population here. In the middle of what is now Germany these two migratory movements met. Could this be the background to the mysterious murders of Eulau?

programme.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
programme.desc: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone."

programme.title: Best of Morning Footy
programme.desc: CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is a first-of-its-kind free, 24-hour channel in the U.S.dedicated exclusively to global soccer coverage. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK, with its unparalleled coverage of all the top domestic and international soccer competitions across the globe, is the ultimate year-round streaming destination for soccer fans. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is anchored weekdays from 7:00-9:00 AM, ET, by - MORNING FOOTY, the Network’s flagship morning show. Every weekday, MORNING FOOTY host Susannah Collins along with former U.S. Men’s National Team player Charlie Davies, analyst Nico Cantor and comedian Alexis Guerreros bring their unique voices and fresh perspectives to the latest news and storylines impacting soccer worldwide. As soccer’s new staple show for fans everywhere, MORNING FOOTY delivers a daily dose of razor-sharp insights and laughs with match highlights, compelling analysis, entertaining interviews, updates - from reporter Jenny Chiu and more that is sure to help kick off your day. In addition, the Network will feature live matches, pre- and post-match breakdowns, magazine shows, films from Paramount+’s STORIES FROM THE BEAUTIFUL GAME soccer documentary collection and original programming. The Network’s live matches and re-airs utilize CBS Sports’ collection of top-tier soccer properties, including UEFA club competitions, Serie A, NWSL, Concacaf national team competitions, Barclays Women’s Super League, Campeonato Brasileirão Série A, Scottish Professional Football League, Argentina Liga Profesional de Fútbol and the AFC Champions League, among others. Watch CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and all 365 days a year.

programme.title: The Vault
programme.desc: 2003 was an epic year for the FIJI PRO. Andy Irons took down Cory Lopez in an epic battle to win the event. Andy was ripping the entire contest and put the world on watch that he was coming for his second world title. - Andy and Cory: It happens a lot on tour, friends who travel and stay together end up in the same heat surfing against each other. Sometimes ‘friendship' stays on the beach and other times they go out and see who can get the best waves and have a fun surf. Andy got on a roll on the Final day of the contest, throwing down 9's and 10's through the Quarter, Semi and Final. He had a perfect 10 and backup 9 point rides before good mate Cory had even put a score on the board. There were three perfect 10 point scores handed out during this Quiksilver Pro Fiji and Andy scored them all. It was Andy at his best in a year when he won 5 out of the 12 CT events and a second World Title.

Relive Final's Day action as the world's best fight to stay on tour and earn critical points in the World Title race.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Jed Clampett is told by a representative of an oil company that the swamp behind his shack is full of oil. (The oil company employee has been hauled in by Jed's daughter Elly May who asks whether she can keep him.) Later, Mr. Brewster, the head of the oil company, does a deal with Jed. Jed tells Cousin Pearl that he'll receive 25 to 100 of "some new kind of dollar." Pearl, thinking Jed has been "slickered", asks what kind of dollar he's talking about. "Million dollars," Granny, Jed's mother-in-law, replies. "Jed, you're a millionaire," Pearl says. "Yeah, that's what that Brewster fella said." Pearl convinces Jed to move to Beverly Hills, California (she pronounces it "Cal-i-forn-ee") and volunteers her son, Jethro, to drive Jed, Elly May and Granny there. Upon arriving, Granny complains the hills aren't that high. Jed says at least there are hills and "we'll be among our own kind of people." The Clampett clan mistakes their new home for a prison and the groundskeepers for prisoners. The Clampetts end up in jail, but Milburn Drysdale, their new banker, gets them freed. But, as Drysdale tries to take the Clampetts to their new mansion, the foursome flee, fearing they're going to prison.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: The Clampetts begin to settle in their new home in Beverly Hills, California. They are having to adjust to things such as refrigerators (Granny remarks how a ham will require two days to thaw out), ovens and the "cement pond." Jed also is having to confront how his daughter Elly May is maturing. He tells her that he, in effect, raised her as a boy and should not have. Jethro also encounters a flamingo that he thinks is a chicken (which causes Jed to suspect Jethro has been sneaking drinks of moonshine). Meanwhile, Miss Hathaway, executive secretary to banker Milburn Drysdale, mistakes the Clampetts for "domestic" help. She thinks Granny is a cook and Elly a maid.

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The biggest Toy in the shop is back... HEAVY METAL! Yes... Our old junk yard International Tow Truck rolls back into the garage as the freshly painted cab returns from the Hot Rot Institute. And it’s not just any paint, It’s Razzleberry from Axalta that’s so candy, you’ll want to take a bite! But there’s no time for that because Stacey jumps right in to putting a face and interior back in this old junkyard dog. The result will make you really glad that he rescued this one from the crusher! It’s recycling at it’s best... it’s GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: We’re moving full steam ahead with the Interior of the Heavy Metal cab coming together and now’s the time to get the dash set up. We’ve got new gauges, old gauges and a bunch of empty holes where switches and knobs lived in this truck’s former life. Stacey lays out the dos and donts of getting your dash updated and a layout that makes sense before it gets installed. GearZ hits the road with a special delivery for the Hot Rod Institute for all they’ve done for us and the restoration industry. Feeling a little down about your project? Well, Stacey has a tool tech that’s sure to lift you up! All this and more on GearZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The SR-71 Rapid Tool Express returns as Stacey digs into his old ’59 ford panel truck and shows how to convert it into a one-off tool delivery truck to show off a variety of Cornwell tools. From special shelves, lighting and floor, there are even a few surprises that are tucked away inside this rolling tool cart! Moving to the cab of the vehicle, Stacey addresses some of the issues people have when setting up seats and steering, and shows some simple tricks that make a huge difference in getting your seats and steering dialed in. Then it’s on the rear to lay out the gas tank, and then finally the SR-71 gets a new beak.... from a ’59 T-bird! ...What?!?.... how is that possible? Well, ya gotta watch GEARZ to find out!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: The Jeep may be the single most modified vehicle out there. From winches to lights, doors and fenders, if you’ve got a Jeep, it probably has some accessories on it. But despite all that, one of the best things about a Jeep is the removable top. It also sparks one of the biggest debates... What is best: a soft top or a hard top? Stacey takes on the challenge by comparing a factory hard top with the new Bestop Trektop. The test will include everything from ease of install to styling, overall sound decibels and of course, how watertight it is. Hopefully you won’t get wet on this ride! Then it’s back to the shop where Stacey shows you that rotisseries aren’t just for chickens, and how an automotive rotisserie can make life in the shop a lot easier. Finally, it’s on to the right and wrong way to use weatherstrip adhesive to hold your rubbers on. Sound risqué? It’s not... it’s just GEARZ!

programme.title: Stacey David's Gearz
programme.desc: It’s all about square body GM trucks, because The Stunt Double is back in the shop. First, we take a look back at the this awesome ‘86 Chevy 4x4 Silverado long bed build that pays tribute to the legendary Fall Guy TV truck. From its beginnings as a well-worn farm truck, you’ll see it get an upgraded suspension, interior, drivetrain, as we make it better than I was before... better... stronger... faster... wait, that was a DIFFERENT Lee Majors TV show! After that, we walk you through the paint job and show how it is similar to the Fall Guy truck, only different.... because It’s the Stunt Double!!! No hocus pocus... no movie magic... just a tough truck being built to handle the toughest stunts... only on GEARZ!

programme.title: The Ed Sullivan Show
programme.desc: "The Ed Sullivan Show" is TV's longest-running variety show. It ran on Sunday nights for an amazing 23 years. The show's host, Ed Sullivan, had been a syndicated newspaper columnist who hosted two radio shows before agreeing to try television. On camera, Sullivan always seemed nervous and ill at ease; he couldn't sing or dance, but he knew people who could and signed them to appear each week. Called "Toast of the Town" until 1955, "The Ed Sullivan Show" featured the TV debuts of artists such as Irving Berlin, Hedy Lamarr, Walt Disney, and Fred Astaire and Jane Powell. The format of the show changed very little over the years, with Sullivan presenting acts that tried to please everyone. A typical show might include a few comics, an aria performed by an opera diva, an acrobat and maybe a plug for a new film from a well-known movie star.

Called "Toast of the Town" until 1955, "The Ed Sullivan Show" featured the TV debuts of artists such as Irving Berlin, Hedy Lamarr, Walt Disney, and Fred Astaire and Jane Powell. The format of the show changed very little over the years, with Sullivan presenting acts that tried to please everyone. A typical show might include a few comics, an aria performed by an opera diva, an acrobat and maybe a plug for a new film from a well-known movie star.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Abril va a llevarle el bebé a Vicenta y llevarse con ella a Alejandrito; pero Abril, junto a Ángel, llegan cuando Federico y Vicenta están discutiendo, entonces, Federico, le dice a Abril que se lleve a ese bebé, porque no es su hijo, porque él es estéril. Abril se lleva al niño y lo cuidan junto con Karelis. Vicenta, se va a la casa de unos tíos, hasta que resuelva la situación con Federico. Pero Federico se altera, y tiene una discusión muy fuerte con Vicenta donde le dice que es una mentirosa y farsante, y que seguramente, ese bebé es hijo de Christian, porque ellos estaban casados y seguramente, se acostó con él. Federico tira cosas y Vicenta se va de la casa.

programme.title: Episodio 24: Luis y la aparici n de Emperatriz
programme.desc: Luis habla con In s acerca de su decisi n de irse de la casa y se da cuenta que no puede hacerlo por su familia. Marisela llega llorando al jard n para hablar con Che to, pero ste no la entiende y sale corriendo. D bora invita a Luis a la fiesta de Walter. Berta pregunta por Emperatriz y Campuzano le dice que la vio con Marisela en la avenida. In s y Asunta se sorprenden de ver a Emperatriz en la casa de los Nu ez. Emperatriz empieza hablar cosas sin sentido e In s le ofrece un te. Flavia se presenta en la oficina de Armando y se lo lleva a comer a un restaurante rom ntico. Armando trata de justificar una llamada de Solbella diciendo que es por el negocio.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 25: El Secreto de la Foto Perdida
programme.desc: Daniela llega al local nocturno para la fiesta de Walter y está nerviosa esperando que llegue Luis, por fin llega en compañía de Inés a quien Walter saluda muy cordialmente. Flavia le reclama a Berta la forma humillante que trató a Marisela, pero Berta se defiende y le dice que en casa a normas que hay que cumplir y si no lo hace se tiene que ir,. Flavia trata de explicarle a Armando la forma tan cruel que Berta ha castigado a Marisela. Flavia con Brígida tratan de calmar a Marisela para que pueda comer, quien poco a poco intenta hacerlo. Marisela a explica a Flavia porque Berta se enojó tanto con ella y le detalla lo sucedido con Emperatriz quien tenía una foto del padre de Reinaldo Núñez y ella la llevó a esa casa.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 26: Disparo de Daniela contra Ines
programme.desc: Inés y Luis Guillermo regresan de la fiesta de Walter, mientras tanto Daniela llega borracha a su casa con Robert y luego se mete al cuarto de Ines y le reclama el haber estado con Luis guillermo en la fiesta cuando ella le había indicado el no acercarcele, le apunta con una pistola, y le dispara, entonces Luis Guillermo y Diego Andrés, al oir el disparo corren a ver que pasó.Gabriela y Victoria les informan lo sucedido. Diego Andrés le comenta a Daniela la suerte que tuvo pues el disparo dio fue exactamente en la pared. Luis Guillermo comenta el que Daniela esta vez fue demasiado lejos. Y pienza que nunca imaginó que Daniela iba a cometer esa locura, a lo que Asunta le dice a Luis Guillermo que debería denunciar por el intento de asesinato.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 27: Michelle Amenaza con Quitarse la Vida
programme.desc: Michelle desde la azotea del edificio, amenaza con tirarse al vacio, en eso Armando. Bertha, y Flavia tratan de convencerla para que no lo haga. Flavia llama a Diego para decirle lo que está sucediendo con Mitchelle, luego este se traslada al sitio y trata de convencer a Mitchellec que desista de su intencion.. Diego logra retener a Mitchelle pero Armando se la arrebata de sus manos y se aleja con ella..Diego llama a casa de Mitchelle para saber sobre su estado cuando el médico le está examinando, a lo cual concluye que fue sometida auna gran presión pero que ya se está estabilizando y le ordena su tratamiento.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 28: El Viaje de Reinaldo y Venganza de Michelle
programme.desc: En el aeropuerto Reinaldo inicia su viaje hacia una nueva vida convertido en otra persona. Inés y Luis Guillermo recuerdan a Reinaldo quien los sorprendió con su repentina muerte Jean Paul los interrumpe informándolos acerca de lo acontecido por Michelle en la disquera. Michelle tras haber sido echada por Diego Andrés desquita su ira con Marisela quien es la víctima inocente de su odio, Bertha aprovechándose de la situación maltrata a Marisela quien se ve a merced de todas sus maldades. Armando percatado de la situación entre Michelle y Diego Andrés le exige a este casarse con su hija amenazándolo con llevarlo a la cárcel por haber estado involucrado con una menor, Diego Andrés intenta defenderse del ataque de Armando al confesarle sus sentimientos.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, María Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandonó a las dos mucho tiempo atrás para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de María Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que también tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relación extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. María Antonieta fallece después de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 40: Socorro Reclama, Karen y Salvador se Casan
programme.desc: Socorro sigue impactada por el beso que vio entre Karen y Salvador. Karen, amorosa con “su novio”, le cuenta a Socorro que se casará con Salvador. Socorro se aleja sorprendida. Cuando llega a su casa, Salvador se encuentra de nuevo con Socorro, quien le reclama con vehemencia esperando que él le cuente la historia que ha tenido con Karen. entra a su exsuegra Sara en un hospital siquiátrico, pero la mujer está tan enferma que no hace caso a ninguna de las preguntas que Josefina le hace.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 40: Dudas, Secretos y Cartas de Amor
programme.desc: En su enfrentamiento de hombre a hombre con Jes s, Gabriel se ve impedido a disimular la duda que lo agobia en cuanto a la vida marital de Marisela al darse cuenta de que la pareja se mantiene conviviendo en camas separadas, Jes s busca una excusa cre ble para hacer que las dudas de Gabriel se evadan y este quede satisfecho con su explicaci n acerca de la felicidad que sienten Marisela y el al haberse convertido en un matrimonio. Marisela alerta a Bertica de la llegada de Ricardo dej ndose llevar por la angustia de que su hijo y Gabriel se encuentren al sentir la culpa de haber mantenido oculto su vinculo como padre e hijo. En el s tano Aurora se deja invadir por la curiosidad al encontrar unas antiguas cartas de amor.

programme.title: Episodio 83: Dudas, celos y culpa navideña.
programme.desc: Estando en su casa, Tatiana le pregunta a Doroteo que si durmió con la mamá, y se arma una discusión entre ellas, En la casa de Gladys se preparan para la navidad, arreglando y decorando, ella se da cuenta de que Dileydis esta como triste y le pregunta que si es por el hombre ese, ella le dice que ¡no! que ya se le va a pasar. Gladys les da consejos de cómo ser feliz y le dice que tiene que echar para adelante y olvidarse de él. Igualmente Eglee, habla con Luis Fernando diciéndole que tiene que ser feliz y no estar sufriendo, el le dice que está bien y que también se le va pasar. Rómulo y Betzaida acaban de llegar de su luna de miel, ella esta algo enojada porque se vinieron antes por culpa de Eglee, el le promete que planearán otra salida y que la complacerá en todo para serla feliz. Pascuita llama a Gonzalo para hablar en su casa el tema de salvar su matrimonio con Matilde, mientras que Matilde y Monchito están de compras navideñas, casualmente se consiguen y compran el mismo regalo para sus parejas un ¡maletín!, Pascuita continua hablando con Gonzalo y le hace varias propuestas para que sean felices los dos, entre ellas esta la idea de casarse y tener una segunda luna miel. Felicita llega a la casa de Luis Fernando para hablar con el, le dice que esta feliz de que esté con María gracia, él le contesta que ella también fue muy importante cuando estaban saliendo, se va y se encuentra a Tatiana y le dice lo mismo, que ella es una mujer espectacular, bella y atractiva. Estando en el carro se encuentra a Maria Gracia y le dice igualmente que ella es muy importante para él, se va y se pone a pensar de que le sirve tener tanta muchacha bella si está amargado extrañando a Dileydis. Dileydis y Luis Fernando se poner a pensar en su relación y en que fue que fallaron, en el fondo se mueren de ganas de esta juntos. En casa de Eglee están reunidas Cristinita, Maria Gracia, Tatiana y Felicita, estas dos hablan un poco envidiosas sobre la relación de Maria Gracia y Luis Fernando diciendo que no es nada serio y simplemente ella es un resuelve. Eglee habla con Gladys sobre la sorpresiva llegada de Rómulo, sintiéndose culpable de su interrupción en la luna de miel. Betzaida, Matilde, Pascuita y la nena se ponen a pensar en sus relaciones personales y a sentirse culpable de su situación en pareja. Luis Fernando también siente sentimiento de culpa por Dileidys, Santiago le dice que se tiene que concentrar en el trabajo y olvidarse de eso, Luis Fernando piensa en quien pudo ser la persona involucrada en el cambio de Dileydis hacia él y llegan a la conclusión de que Maria Gracia tiene algo que ver. Dileydis y Yenilú conversan de la situación de su relación y del porque el cambio de Luis Fernando, llegando a la conclusión de que a él no le gustan las mujeres pobres. Luis Fernando sigue conversando con Santiago y se niega a pensar que Maria Gracia haya sido la culpable de que Dileydis haya cambiado con él, Santiago le dice que ella conocía la relación que tenia con ella y que deje de dudarlo ya que es quien armó el problema para separarlos. Rómulo y Betzaida llegan a trabajar a la oficina y todos se quedan asombrados por su corta luna de miel, sobretodo Eglee quien se burla de él alegando que sigue siendo el mismo hombre aburrido de siempre. La Nena llega a casa de una de sus alumnas y se enoja porque no se encuentra, cree que la pava se le ha vendido encima porque todas las cosas malas la persiguen y que no tiene fuerza de voluntad para sacarse de la cabeza a Doroteo. En el negocio de Gabito, Doroteo habla de su relación con la Nena alegando que ella lo quiere y que ya se olvidó de su antiguo esposo, el difunto. En la oficina Betzaida y Eglee se ponen a discutir en su mente sobre Rómulo y a tirarse puntas, en ese momento llega un ramo de flores y el señor pregunta que si se encuentra la señora de garcía, y responden las dos ¡soy yo! sin saber realmente a quien va dirigido.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Abril va a llevarle el bebé a Vicenta y llevarse con ella a Alejandrito; pero Abril, junto a Ángel, llegan cuando Federico y Vicenta están discutiendo, entonces, Federico, le dice a Abril que se lleve a ese bebé, porque no es su hijo, porque él es estéril. programme.desc: En su enfrentamiento de hombre a hombre con Jes s, Gabriel se ve impedido a disimular la duda que lo agobia en cuanto a la vida marital de Marisela al darse cuenta de que la pareja se mantiene conviviendo en camas separadas, Jes s busca una excusa cre ble para hacer que las dudas de Gabriel se evadan y este quede satisfecho con su explicaci n acerca de la felicidad que sienten Marisela y el al haberse convertido en un matrimonio. Marisela alerta a Bertica de la llegada de Ricardo dej ndose llevar por la angustia de que su hijo y Gabriel se encuentren al sentir la culpa de haber mantenido oculto su vinculo como padre e hijo. En el s tano Aurora se deja invadir por la curiosidad al encontrar unas antiguas cartas de amor.

programme.title: Episodio 83: Dudas, celos y culpa navideña.
programme.desc: Estando en su casa, Tatiana le pregunta a Doroteo que si durmió con la mamá, y se arma una discusión entre ellas, En la casa de Gladys se preparan para la navidad, arreglando y decorando, ella se da cuenta de que Dileydis esta como triste y le pregunta que si es por el hombre ese, ella le dice que ¡no! que ya se le va a pasar. Gladys les da consejos de cómo ser feliz y le dice que tiene que echar para adelante y olvidarse de él. Igualmente Eglee, habla con Luis Fernando diciéndole que tiene que ser feliz y no estar sufriendo, el le dice que está bien y que también se le va pasar. Rómulo y Betzaida acaban de llegar de su luna de miel, ella esta algo enojada porque se vinieron antes por culpa de Eglee, el le promete que planearán otra salida y que la complacerá en todo para serla feliz. Pascuita llama a Gonzalo para hablar en su casa el tema de salvar su matrimonio con Matilde, mientras que Matilde y Monchito están de compras navideñas, casualmente se consiguen y compran el mismo regalo para sus parejas un ¡maletín!, Pascuita continua hablando con Gonzalo y le hace varias propuestas para que sean felices los dos, entre ellas esta la idea de casarse y tener una segunda luna miel. Felicita llega a la casa de Luis Fernando para hablar con el, le dice que esta feliz de que esté con María gracia, él le contesta que ella también fue muy importante cuando estaban saliendo, se va y se encuentra a Tatiana y le dice lo mismo, que ella es una mujer espectacular, bella y atractiva. Estando en el carro se encuentra a Maria Gracia y le dice igualmente que ella es muy importante para él, se va y se pone a pensar de que le sirve tener tanta muchacha bella si está amargado extrañando a Dileydis. Dileydis y Luis Fernando se poner a pensar en su relación y en que fue que fallaron, en el fondo se mueren de ganas de esta juntos. En casa de Eglee están reunidas Cristinita, Maria Gracia, Tatiana y Felicita, estas dos hablan un poco envidiosas sobre la relación de Maria Gracia y Luis Fernando diciendo que no es nada serio y simplemente ella es un resuelve. Eglee habla con Gladys sobre la sorpresiva llegada de Rómulo, sintiéndose culpable de su interrupción en la luna de miel. Betzaida, Matilde, Pascuita y la nena se ponen a pensar en sus relaciones personales y a sentirse culpable de su situación en pareja. Luis Fernando también siente sentimiento de culpa por Dileidys, Santiago le dice que se tiene que concentrar en el trabajo y olvidarse de eso, Luis Fernando piensa en quien pudo ser la persona involucrada en el cambio de Dileydis hacia él y llegan a la conclusión de que Maria Gracia tiene algo que ver. Dileydis y Yenilú conversan de la situación de su relación y del porque el cambio de Luis Fernando, llegando a la conclusión de que a él no le gustan las mujeres pobres. Luis Fernando sigue conversando con Santiago y se niega a pensar que Maria Gracia haya sido la culpable de que Dileydis haya cambiado con él, Santiago le dice que ella conocía la relación que tenia con ella y que deje de dudarlo ya que es quien armó el problema para separarlos. Rómulo y Betzaida llegan a trabajar a la oficina y todos se quedan asombrados por su corta luna de miel, sobretodo Eglee quien se burla de él alegando que sigue siendo el mismo hombre aburrido de siempre. La Nena llega a casa de una de sus alumnas y se enoja porque no se encuentra, cree que la pava se le ha vendido encima porque todas las cosas malas la persiguen y que no tiene fuerza de voluntad para sacarse de la cabeza a Doroteo. En el negocio de Gabito, Doroteo habla de su relación con la Nena alegando que ella lo quiere y que ya se olvidó de su antiguo esposo, el difunto. En la oficina Betzaida y Eglee se ponen a discutir en su mente sobre Rómulo y a tirarse puntas, en ese momento llega un ramo de flores y el señor pregunta que si se encuentra la señora de garcía, y responden las dos ¡soy yo! sin saber realmente a quien va dirigido.

programme.desc: A betzaida R mulo le manda un ramo de rosas rojas a la oficina, Egl e ve ese hecho y furica se descarga con marco Aurelio de que R mulo nunca le hizo ese gesto. Eglee llama a Gladis para que le avise a Gabriel para que repare un tubo roto en el ba o de la oficina. Gabriel acude y habla con marco y le dice que Gladis es una gran mujer humilde y que no merece que le pinten villas ni castillas. Marco aurelio le dice que l tambi n la aprecia y que Gladis no necesita quien la defienda porque ella lo hace sola. Tatianita sale con Luis Fernando, ste aprovecha para buscar en la via a Dileidy trabajando, cuando la ve la ve hablando con Aureliano. Ella ve que l anda con una catirita, ambos le dicen con la persona con la que est n que podr an pasear al cine. Dileidy y Luis Fernando piensan que no quieren verse mas. Dileidy le reclama a aureliano que no tenia porqu decirle a Luis Fernando de que ella le dec a novio a todo el mundo. Aureliano no reconoce este hecho ante ella. Maria gracia por su parte en el cine con Luis Fernando no reconoce que ella fue quien le dijo a dileidy que Luis Fernando se burlaba de su pobreza. Gonzalo ve en el arbolito de su casa un regalo extra o Matilde le dice que ella se autoregal eso para ella. la misma excusa la dice ramon en su casa. A Pascuita le parece extra o que ramon se autoregale algo. Gladis le pide a marco darle una pasantia a Dileidy. Marco acepta encantado Gladis celebra en la bodega de Gabriel pero ste se molesta cuando ella le dice que la pasantia se la consigui marco. Eglee por su parte le pide a su jefe que le de un buen proyecto a santiago y Luis Fernando. Marco accede. Gladis y Eglee piensan que con el trabajo que le consiguen a sus respectivos hijos dejaran de pensar en sus respectivas parejas. Doroteo le comenta a Gabriel que menos mal que aristigueta esta muerto porque sino l no podr a seguir con la nena. La nena le reprocha c mo se le ocurre ni siquiera dirigirle la palabra cuando ella tuvo que sobrevivir sola y que l nunca se ocup de ellas, Aristigueta le dice que su delito prescribi y que siente que ella no haya sabido nada de l. programme.title: La Cacería: En el fin del mundo
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: En el fin del mundo - Episodio 01
programme.desc: La pesadilla comienza cuando José Mirkovic, un adolescente solitario y alumno de un colegio de curas, desaparece tras una noche de fiesta. Ante la indiferencia policial y el silencio de la Iglesia, su madre, Susana Rivera, inicia una cruzada para descubrir la verdad. Tras semanas sin respuestas, aparece un extraño que ofrece esperanza: César Rojas, ex policía convertido en investigador privado, marcado por un pasado turbulento. Junto a la joven oficial Antonia Loij, Rojas sigue el rastro del enigmático padre Correa, ex director del colegio de José, quien parece esconder más de un secreto. Mientras Susana y Rojas luchan por resolver el caso y descubrir qué le sucedió a José, en Santiago el capitán Rodrigo Carrasco, antiguo compañero de Rojas en la policía, recibe una alerta sobre el caso. En las sombras, una red de encubrimientos comienza a cerrarse, mientras crece el temor de que este y otros crímenes enterrados salgan a la luz.

programme.title: La Cacería: En el fin del mundo
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: En el fin del mundo - Episodio 02
programme.desc: Mientras Rojas y Loij reconstruyen la oscura historia del padre Correa, se exponen diversos encubrimientos que alcanzan las áreas más sensibles del poder. Mientras el arzobispo Moretti mueve sus piezas para proteger a los implicados en la Iglesia, Carrasco recibe nuevas órdenes: silenciar a los investigadores independientes a cualquier precio. Cuando las primeras amenazas se hacen realidad, Loij comprende que para encontrar la verdad deberá arriesgar su vida. Pero Rojas no se deja intimidar fácilmente. Resolver el caso se ha convertido en su misión personal: a través de su búsqueda enfrentará sus propios demonios ligados a abusos sufridos en el pasado. La caza del escurridizo Correa ha revelado una red de secretos, negocios turbios y pactos tras bambalinas entre la Iglesia y las fuerzas del orden. Alguien deberá caer para destruir el pacto de silencio.

programme.title: La Cacería: En el fin del mundo
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: En el fin del mundo - Episodio 03
programme.desc: La noche más oscura cae sobre el detective y su aliada justo cuando creen estar más cerca de la verdad. En un movimiento final arriesgado, Rojas se enfrenta al sacerdote que lo abusó, pero el cara a cara con el padre Correa no será fácil. En él, revivirá sus peores pesadillas. Mientras un testigo clave señala al padre Correa como autor del crimen, Carrasco recibe la orden de eliminar el último cabo suelto. Cuando el cuerpo de Correa aparece en circunstancias extrañas, Rojas sospechará la peor de las traiciones. Acorralado y solo frente a una mafia poderosa dispuesta a todo, Rojas entenderá que la justicia siempre ha estado fuera de su alcance. Incluso con un enfrentamiento público final por parte de la familia de José, la verdad no podrá salir a la luz.

programme.title: La Cacería: En el fin del mundo
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: En el fin del mundo - Episodio 01
programme.desc: La pesadilla comienza cuando José Mirkovic, un adolescente solitario y alumno de un colegio de curas, desaparece tras una noche de fiesta. Ante la indiferencia policial y el silencio de la Iglesia, su madre, Susana Rivera, inicia una cruzada para descubrir la verdad. Tras semanas sin respuestas, aparece un extraño que ofrece esperanza: César Rojas, ex policía convertido en investigador privado, marcado por un pasado turbulento. Junto a la joven oficial Antonia Loij, Rojas sigue el rastro del enigmático padre Correa, ex director del colegio de José, quien parece esconder más de un secreto. Mientras Susana y Rojas luchan por resolver el caso y descubrir qué le sucedió a José, en Santiago el capitán Rodrigo Carrasco, antiguo compañero de Rojas en la policía, recibe una alerta sobre el caso. En las sombras, una red de encubrimientos comienza a cerrarse, mientras crece el temor de que este y otros crímenes enterrados salgan a la luz.

programme.title: Amor en Whitbrooke
programme.desc: A una ambiciosa gestora de proyectos le ofrecen la oportunidad profesional de su vida en Londres. Pero cuando regresa a su ciudad natal para ayudar al negocio familiar en una emergencia y conoce al chico perfecto, su pasión y talento por la pintura se reavivan, dándole una nueva perspectiva de la vida y el amor.

programme.title: La Bella Y La Bestia
programme.desc: Eric Landry es un hombre de corazón frío al que la gente ha apodado "la Bestia". Años de ira y amargura lo han consumido, convirtiéndolo en un hombre egoísta. Pero Belle Watson es exactamente lo contrario. Ella es cariñosa y amable. Trabaja duro para ayudar a su familia, a menudo sacrificando sus propias necesidades y deseos para satisfacer las necesidades de los demás. Cuando su padre rompe accidentalmente una valiosa obra de arte en la mansión Landry, Bella se ve inmersa en la vida de la Bestia. Haciendo todo lo posible por no dejarse intimidar por su mezquindad, Belles acepta trabajar para Eric en un esfuerzo por pagarle y salvar el trabajo de su padre. Ella descubre que podría haber más en Eric. ¿Encontrará al hombre dentro de la Bestia?

programme.title: Alimento para El Corazón
programme.desc: Los planes de la chef Lia de ampliar su servicio sin ánimo de lucro de reparto de comida a domicilio centrado en el corazón fracasan debido a su insistencia en hacerlo todo ella misma. Pero con la ayuda de su nuevo vecino y reciente padre adoptivo Eli descubrirá que los negocios, al igual que el romance, pueden florecer con un poco de esfuerzo y confianza.

programme.title: La Bella y el Billonario
programme.desc: El lanzamiento del producto de Mason está fracasando, lo que lo lleva a dificultarle la vida a Jess. Stan quiere hablar sobre los errores empresariales de Mason durante una cena con algunos amigos de confianza. Pero Belle Watson es exactamente lo contrario. Ella es cariñosa y amable. Trabaja duro para ayudar a su familia, a menudo sacrificando sus propias necesidades y deseos para satisfacer las necesidades de los demás. Cuando su padre rompe accidentalmente una valiosa obra de arte en la mansión Landry, Bella se ve inmersa en la vida de la Bestia. Haciendo todo lo posible por no dejarse intimidar por su mezquindad, Belles acepta trabajar para Eric en un esfuerzo por pagarle y salvar el trabajo de su padre. programme.desc: Andréi se enamora de Sima, pero ella lo rechaza. Vania y Larisa se mudan a la ciudad. Larisa lo abandona, dejándole a su hijo. Irina es amenazada por delincuentes por ayudar a Vania.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Vania e Irina son secuestrados por criminales. Sima y Andréi intentan rescatarlos. Irina se arrepiente de su pasado y pide perdón. Los prisioneros intentan escapar.

programme.title: Salsa
programme.desc: La salsa es un baile latinoamericano, cuya emoción y energía que desborda pueden derretir hasta la nieve de Rusia. No es de extrañar que en el ambiente de la salsa se sientan atraídas personas completamente diferentes que quieren cambiar algo en sus vidas, llenarlas de sentido y de colores nuevos. En la salsa puedes darte cuenta de todo, porque cada baile es una pequeña historia de amor. Irina Kanevskaya también cae bajo el encanto de la salsa. Ella es jefa de un departamento bancario, con una carrera exitosa, pero desde hace tiempo se encuentra sentada en su aburrido trabajo y ha perdido el gusto por la vida. Pero un encuentro inesperado con Igor Samoilov, un bailarín de salsa experimentado, provoca un cambio radical en su forma de vivir.

programme.title: Salsa
programme.desc: Lucía llega a Moscú con Denis. Irina enfrenta amenazas en su trabajo y descubre la traición de su hijo. Tatiana sospecha que Asya consume drogas, mientras que Lucía es acosada en un tren y detenida.

programme.title: Salsa
programme.desc: Chino rescata a Lucía y le ofrece trabajo en su club. Igor insiste en que Irina aprenda salsa. Asya es expulsada de la academia y Tatiana planea llevársela a Alemania.

programme.desc: Petr acusa a Oleg de fraude. Igor y Chino se preparan para un concurso de baile. Olga expulsa a Serguéi tras recibir fotos comprometedoras. Tatiana descubre que Asya trabaja en un club nocturno.
